description: Source code of the PermissionDaoImpl class, which implements data access methods for Permission entities, including listing permissions, fetching by ID, filtering by group IDs, and querying with criteria.

classes.name: PermissionDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of PermissionDao for accessing permission data from the database.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Returns a list of all permissions ordered by ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Permission entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getPermissionsListByGroups
methods.description: Fetches permissions associated with specific group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Provides a paginated list of permissions matching given criteria, including filters and count.
